issues.reason: (Past (KindProperty corruption widespread)) standing alone claims corruption was widespread at large, which asserts more than "widespread in Persia" states, and the companion locative atom cannot restrict it because a kind symbol is global — the restriction has to sit in the property atom itself.

LocatedIn is specified for "where a THING is", (LocatedIn <entity> <place>), so the bare kind/mass symbol corruption in its entity slot mixes kind and individual positions the way the Member/Inheritance discipline forbids, and the mechanical past-copular rule that wraps every categorical atom the clause yields makes the untensed emission wrong as well.

(Inheritance discipline lax) predicates laxness of the kind discipline, which inherits to every instance anywhere, whereas the text restricts the claim to discipline in the army — over-assertion under Core patterns.

An army is an organization, not a place, so "in the army" is the framing / domain PP the instruction set routes away from LocatedIn ("a place inside a place is LocatedIn"), and the kind symbol discipline is again in a slot specified for an entity.

gaps_confirmed: a locative / restrictive PP scoping a kind-level or mass-noun property claim ("corruption was widespread in Persia", "discipline in the army was lax"): nothing says whether it belongs in ConditionalProperty's condition slot (the causeway precedent), in a LocatedIn atom, or restricting a minted witness

abstract mass-noun subject of a copular clause (corruption, discipline): the individual-vs-kind test and the plural determiner test decide nothing for a bare or post-modified mass noun in subject position
new_gaps: a domain / sphere preposition attached to an ENTITY rather than to a claim or event ("discipline in the army"): the framing-PP rule gives (In <what-is-claimed> <domain>) and the entity-attached surface-preposition precedent is stated only for origin "from" ((From sk_wool_1 calderwick)), so entity-attached In is licensed only by analogy

ConditionalProperty is the only device for restricting a kind-level property, but it carries cond_prop distribution, so a NON-distributing property (the KindProperty family: widespread, extinct, common) has no restricted form that keeps its non-distributing character
repair_summary: Folded the locative restriction into the property atom, replacing (Past (KindProperty corruption widespread)) + (LocatedIn corruption persia) with (Past (ConditionalProperty corruption widespread persia)) on the "Trailers are permitted on the causeway" precedent, keeping the parser's 1.0/0.9 TV; made the second clause's subject the specific referent it is — witness sk_discipline_1 typed by Member (the mass-witness shape of the partitive section), restricted by the entity-attached (In sk_discipline_1 sk_army_1), replacing (LocatedIn discipline sk_army_1); re-based (Past (Inheritance discipline lax)) as (Past (Member sk_discipline_1 lax)) and moved the untouched Degree atom onto the same symbol for coherence, both now individual facts at (STV 1.0 0.99) instead of the generic 0.9/0.9.
notes: The Degree atom was not itself faulted, but its subject symbol had to follow the confirmed fix to the property it grades, which also settles the reviewer's note that a degree level is not a proportion. The NP-internal (In …) restriction is left untensed like the referent typing atoms, since the clause predicates laxness rather than in-ness.
